walking_graph.assumption: Derived orthogonal free-space corridor graph, not measured engineering geometry; y200 portal selected by designer

provenance.routes: Six source-informed skeletons; 16 synthetic multi-operation variants and two singles. Roles and axes are engineering choices.
provenance.mix: 95% inverse-rank over explicit16-family ranking, 5% single-operation split equally. Synthetic, not fitted Pareto.
provenance.quantities: Approved bounded triangular mean175 after probability normalization; role-independent relative size classes. Not observed market quantities.
provenance.processing: Source family median standard proxies; synthetic fixed complexity and role modifiers, not isolated autonomous measurements.
provenance.machines: 68 retained coordinates; two Honing/two WireEDM; remaining64 apportioned to Milling/Turning by fixed offered reference processing. Source positions preserved where possible.
provenance.axes: 3/4 requirement dominates eligibility; four-axis pool from required workload plus20 percentage-point flexible reserve. Extra axes not a speed factor.
provenance.setup: Three role-based synthetic setup classes per process; fixed transition type; triangular duration; four fixed setup staff.
provenance.workers: Offline manual-capacity sizing with20% transfer allowance; 2:1day/night ratio per floor; fixed employees, not demand-reactive.
provenance.floor: Workers remain on own floor; parts use finite shared freight lift. Three minutes per lift trip is engineering baseline.
provenance.arrivals: Fixed exogenous Poisson, rate chosen offline; no live balancing.
provenance.single_operation_share: 5% engineering baseline, preserves small simple-work representation independently of multi-operation rank law.
